_comment: Configuration for the news.youdle.io article index.
Edit this file, then run:  python blogger/homepage/build_theme.py
Every value is substituted into src/homepage.xml at build time, so the
generated theme contains plain literals and stays readable in Blogger's

site.name: Youdle
site.title: Youdle News
site.tagline: Grocery recalls, price moves and shopper finds — newest first.
site.definition: Youdle brings together grocery news, recalls, price changes, shopper finds, and tools to help people shop smarter.

urls._comment: Verified live 2026-08-31. See README.md 'Link map' for provenance.

_comment: Chips across the top of the index. 'blogger_label' is the raw label as
it exists on the live blog, because that is what Blogger's
/search/label/ URLs match -- they are case sensitive and do not accept
The blog carries both RECALL (9 posts) and recall (7 posts) as separate
labels, so the Recalls chip reaches only the former. Those 7 posts still
appear in the main list, which is chronological and label-blind. The fix
is to relabel them in Blogger; see README 'Label hygiene'.

newsletter._comment: Existing Mailchimp integration, carried over verbatim from the theme's youdleNewsletterSignup includable so subscribers land on the same list.

_comment: Blogger emits <title>, meta description and Open Graph tags from
Settings, so we do NOT duplicate them here. Twitter Card tags are not
emitted by Blogger, so we add those.
